name: tour
snippet:
"use client"

import { Button, Tour as ChakraTour, Portal } from "@chakra-ui/react"
import { CloseButton } from "@/components/ui/close-button"
import * as React from "react"

export interface TourProps extends ChakraTour.RootProps {
  portalled?: boolean
  portalRef?: React.RefObject<HTMLElement | null>
  contentProps?: ChakraTour.ContentProps
}

export const Tour = React.forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, TourProps>(
  function Tour(props, ref) {
    const {
      portalled = true,
      portalRef,
      contentProps,
      children,
      ...rest
    } = props
    return (
      <ChakraTour.Root {...rest}>
        <Portal disabled={!portalled} container={portalRef}>
          <ChakraTour.Backdrop />
          <ChakraTour.Spotlight />
          <ChakraTour.Positioner>
            <ChakraTour.Content ref={ref} {...contentProps}>
              <ChakraTour.Arrow>
                <ChakraTour.ArrowTip />
              </ChakraTour.Arrow>
              <ChakraTour.CloseTrigger asChild>
                <CloseButton size="sm" />
              </ChakraTour.CloseTrigger>
              <ChakraTour.Title />
              <ChakraTour.Description />
              {children}
              <ChakraTour.Control>
                {rest.tour.totalSteps > 1 && <ChakraTour.ProgressText />}
                <TourActions />
              </ChakraTour.Control>
            </ChakraTour.Content>
          </ChakraTour.Positioner>
        </Portal>
      </ChakraTour.Root>
    )
  },
)

const TourActions = () => (
  <ChakraTour.Actions>
    {(actions) =>
      actions.map((action, index) => (
        <ChakraTour.ActionTrigger key={index} action={action} asChild>
          <Button
            size="sm"
            variant={index === actions.length - 1 ? "solid" : "outline"}
          >
            {action.label}
          </Button>
        </ChakraTour.ActionTrigger>
      ))
    }
  </ChakraTour.Actions>
)

examples.name: tour-with-checklist
examples.content:
"use client"
export const TourWithChecklist = () => {
  const [done, setDone] = useState<string[]>([])

  const tour = useTour({
    steps,
    onStatusChange({ status, stepId }) {
      if (status === "dismissed" && stepId) {
        setDone((prev) => (prev.includes(stepId) ? prev : [...prev, stepId]))
      }
    },
  })

  return (
    <Stack gap="5" maxW="md">
      <Stack gap="3" borderWidth="1px" rounded="l3" p="4">
        <Text fontWeight="medium">Get started</Text>
        <Progress.Root size="xs" value={(done.length / steps.length) * 100}>
          <Progress.Track>
            <Progress.Range />
          </Progress.Track>
        </Progress.Root>
        {steps.map((step) => (
          <HStack key={step.id} justify="space-between">
            <Checkbox.Root checked={done.includes(step.id)} readOnly>
              <Checkbox.HiddenInput />
              <Checkbox.Control />
              <Checkbox.Label>{step.title}</Checkbox.Label>
            </Checkbox.Root>
            <Button
              size="xs"
              variant="ghost"
              onClick={() => tour.start(step.id)}
            >
              Show me
            </Button>
          </HStack>
        ))}
      </Stack>

      <HStack gap="3">
        <Button id="checklist-invite" size="sm" variant="outline">
          Invite team
        </Button>
        <Button id="checklist-import" size="sm" variant="outline">
          Import data
        </Button>
        <Button id="checklist-billing" size="sm" variant="outline">
          Billing
        </Button>
      </HStack>

      <Tour tour={tour} />
    </Stack>
  )
}
